stories.title: Trump afirma que Rusia quiere un acuerdo para poner fin a guerra con Ucrania; acusa a Zelenski de negarse

en.title: Trump asserts Russia wants deal to end war with Ukraine; accuses Zelenski of refusing
en.summary: Trump stated that Russia seeks an agreement to conclude the Ukraine conflict and claimed Ukraine's president is unwilling to negotiate. Trump also suggested Ukraine should have different leadership.

stories.title: Autoridad saudita reporta 12 muertos y más de 300 heridos por ataque al aeropuerto de Riad

en.title: Saudi authority reports 12 dead and more than 300 injured in attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh airport resulted in twelve deaths and over three hundred injuries. Hospitals became overwhelmed with wounded transported by ambulances and helicopters.

stories.title: Huracán Simon se posiciona a 135 km de Manzanillo; sigue acercándose a México causando lluvias extraordinarias

en.title: Hurricane Simon positioned 135 km from Manzanillo; continues approaching Mexico causing extraordinary rainfall
en.summary: Hurricane Simon moved closer to Mexico at a distance of 135 kilometers from Manzanillo while bringing heavy rain. Tropical storm Rachel was advancing toward Baja California with strong winds expected.

stories.title: Cierran aeropuerto de Puerto Vallarta por huracán Simon

en.title: Puerto Vallarta airport closes due to Hurricane Simon
en.summary: Puerto Vallarta airport suspended operations beginning Saturday at 6 p.m. and was scheduled to reopen Monday, October 12 at 8 a.m. due to hurricane conditions.

stories.title: Cierran playas de Puerto Vallarta ante la proximidad del huracán Simon; se encuentran en alerta máxima

en.title: Beaches in Puerto Vallarta closed as Hurricane Simon approaches; maximum alert in effect
en.summary: Authorities have closed beaches in Puerto Vallarta and implemented access restrictions as Hurricane Simon approaches the area.

stories.title: Decretan Alerta Roja en Colima y Jalisco por 'Simon'

en.title: Red Alert declared in Colima and Jalisco due to Hurricane Simon
en.summary: Civil Protection declared a Red Alert in Colima and Jalisco as Hurricane Simon approaches, halting activities and prompting evacuations.

stories.title: México en alerta por severidad extrema de Simon y Rachel que avanzan hacia costas de Colima y BC

en.title: Mexico on alert for extreme severity of hurricanes Simon and Rachel advancing toward Colima and Baja California coasts
en.summary: Mexico's weather service forecasts that Hurricanes Simon and Rachel will bring extraordinary rainfall and waves up to 8 meters high in coming hours.

stories.title: Defensa mantiene Plan DN-III-E en Colima, Jalisco y Nayarit por Huracán Simon; despliega a casi 3 mil elementos

en.title: Defense maintains Plan DN-III-E in Colima, Jalisco and Nayarit for Hurricane Simon; deploys nearly 3,000 personnel
en.summary: Mexico's Defense Ministry has activated its emergency response plan for Colima, Jalisco, and Nayarit, deploying approximately 3,000 military personnel to address contingencies from Hurricane Simon.

stories.title: Reportan compras de pánico y largas filas en gasolineras ante llegada del huracán “Simon” a Puerto Vallarta; se esperan lluvias y fuertes vientos

en.title: Panic buying and long lines reported at gas stations as Hurricane Simon approaches Puerto Vallarta; heavy rain and strong winds expected
en.summary: As Hurricane Simon nears Puerto Vallarta, residents are rushing to purchase fuel, creating lengthy queues at gas stations. The region anticipates severe weather including intense rainfall and powerful winds.

stories.title: Huracán Simon categoría 4 amenaza al Pacífico mexicano; estos estados tendrán lluvias torrenciales

en.title: Hurricane Simon category 4 threatens Mexican Pacific; these states will have torrential rains
en.summary: Category 4 Hurricane Simon is approaching the coasts of Colima and Michoacán in Mexico, while tropical storm Rachel could impact Baja California during the night.

stories.title: Huracán Simon ya es categoría 4; alerta en Jalisco y Colima

en.title: Hurricane Simon now Category 4; alerts in Jalisco and Colima
en.summary: Hurricane Simon intensified to Category 4 off Mexico's central Pacific coast and is expected to strengthen further, with heavy to torrential rains forecast for western and southern regions including Guerrero, Michoacán, Colima, Jalisco, and Nayarit.

stories.title: Simon, strengthening rapidly, could hit Jalisco or Colima as a major hurricane this weekend

en.title: Simon, strengthening rapidly, could hit Jalisco or Colima as a major hurricane this weekend
en.summary: Hurricane Simon, currently Category 2, is moving north under hurricane warning from Michoacán to Nayarit with expected landfall in Colima or Jalisco as early as Saturday.

stories.title: Nerds llega oficialmente a México tras años de venta por distribuidores

en.title: Nerds officially arrives in Mexico after years of distributor sales
en.summary: Ferrara Candy Company's Nerds brand launched official operations in Mexico with a strategy combining diverse product formats and marketing activations to build consumer presence.

stories.title: Mantendrá México de las inflaciones médicas más altas en América Latina en 2027

en.title: Mexico to Maintain One of the Highest Medical Inflation Rates in Latin America in 2027
en.summary: Mexico is projected to have one of the highest medical inflation rates in Latin America in 2027, with increases far exceeding general inflation, though at a slower pace than 2026, continuing pressure on business and household budgets.

stories.title: Hacienda baja el IEPS para gasolinas, mientras el diésel va por su quinta semana con cuota cero

en.title: Treasury lowers IEPS for gasoline, while diesel reaches its fifth week with zero tax
en.summary: Mexico's Treasury reduced the special tax on gasoline for the week of October 10-16, with Magna gasoline taxed at 2.39 pesos per liter and Premium at 1.62 pesos, while diesel maintains zero taxation.

stories.title: De equipo de adolescentes a negocio de 490 millones: cómo los Azcárraga convirtieron al América en un imperio

en.title: From teenage team to 490 million business: how the Azcárragas turned América into an empire
en.summary: Club América has evolved from a sports team into a financial asset, with the Azcárraga family now seeking to monetize its fan base, stadium, and brand value.

stories.title: Antes de Chivas y Omnilife, Jorge Vergara se levantaba a las 4:00 de la mañana para vender carnitas

en.title: Before Chivas and Omnilife, Jorge Vergara woke at 4:00 AM to sell carnitas
en.summary: Jorge Vergara faced financial failure early in his career and sold carnitas in the early morning hours before founding his successful companies Chivas and Omnilife.
